definition: Difference between the prior day's implied availability trend and the published designation
inputs_required: Official practice snapshot + game status, day over day
direction_when_positive: Market should move less than the information implies on totals and team-rate markets
decay_note: hours; a designation is stale once the next filing lands
capacity_note: Only fires once per player per week; concentrated on Wednesday/Thursday/Friday filings

definition: Transitions DNP to Limited to Full and the reverse, as an ordinal feature
inputs_required: Official practice snapshot (three filings per week)
direction_when_positive: An upgrade from DNP to Limited raises implied availability more than Limited to Full
capacity_note: High information content; every club files daily

definition: A club whose hub row set is empty while independent official pages report injuries on the same date
inputs_required: Injury hub vs official news pages
direction_when_positive: Absence of a report is a data event, not a health statement
capacity_note: Rare but high value: it flags exactly when a model would be silently wrong

definition: Gap between the departing starter's recent production share and the production share of the player who actually takes the snaps
direction_when_positive: A larger gap should reduce that side's expected efficiency
capacity_note: Needs snap data; the volume-share component is estimable without it

definition: Deficiency computed separately for base front, base back, nickel, goal-line and short-yardage units rather than one team number
inputs_required: Snap data by package + injuries by position
direction_when_positive: A depleted nickel package should lift opponent slot-receiver targets and yards

definition: A designated-to-return player whose practice load is still limited, producing a start/no-start uncertainty the market resolves late
direction_when_positive: Ambiguity inflates the tail of player distributions, which matters more for prop lines than for the spread
capacity_note: Every club has zero to six of these in a given week

definition: Replacement of the starting quarterback between weeks, verified from official reporting only
direction_when_positive: A confirmed chain change should move the team total and the pass-volume props materially more than the spread
capacity_note: Low frequency, very high information content; Week 10 had three confirmed and one unresolved

definition: Explicit discount applied to a team's efficiency when the starter at a run-blocking or pass-rush position is absent and the replacement has negligible prior NFL volume
inputs_required: Projected starter reconstruction + prior playing time
direction_when_positive: Direction depends on which side of the ball

definition: Difference in days of rest between the two clubs, computed only from published kickoff timestamps
direction_when_positive: A short-week club should be shaded on totals and late-game markets
capacity_note: Deterministic and free; fires every Thursday and Monday week

definition: Travel distance, timezone delta and unusual kickoff hour, from official venue and time data only
direction_when_positive: A non-standard kickoff hour should widen the distribution more than it shifts it
capacity_note: Rare; Week 10 has a 09:30 ET game in Munich

definition: Widening of a team's projected-point distribution caused purely by the number of un-declared key players
inputs_required: Designation set + our own distribution model
direction_when_positive: Uncertainty raises the value of the over on totals if the market prices the game as a mean

definition: Sum constraint on a team's pass attempts, rush attempts and targets, so teammates' props cannot all be high at once
direction_when_positive: Negative coupling between two teammates' reception props

definition: Player distribution conditioned on the game total we ourselves originated, rather than on the market total
direction_when_positive: Positive coupling between a stack (QB pass yards plus WR receiving yards) and the game total
capacity_note: The single largest source of hidden correlation in prop combos

definition: Edge of an offered parlay price against our joint estimate, reported alongside the independence baseline for contrast
direction_when_positive: A price above our joint estimate is the bet; a price above the independence baseline is not evidence
capacity_note: Requires a fitted joint model, so the independence baseline must never be the decision variable

definition: Our number minus the consensus benchmark at a fixed decision time, tracked as a distribution rather than a point
direction_when_positive: A persistent positive residual with a tight interval is the definition of originating rather than tailing
capacity_note: Nothing can be published without prices

definition: The share of our residual that arrives after the last public filing but before kickoff
inputs_required: Timestamps on our filings vs benchmark prices
direction_when_positive: If skill is real it concentrates late; if it is noise it is flat across the window
capacity_note: Also the cleanest test that we are not simply echoing public news

definition: Fraction of games a strategy bets, and how that fraction behaves across weeks
direction_when_positive: A strategy that bets 90% of games is asserting a very wide edge; that assertion must be priced
capacity_note: Guards against always-bet models that are really just market avoidance

definition: Bootstrap uncertainty of our own fair value, propagated into the edge, so a small edge with huge error is not a bet
direction_when_positive: Edge must exceed k times the model error, not just the vig
capacity_note: Prevents the classic failure of claiming a 1% edge on a model with a 4% error bar
